_description: Black swan overlay applied on top of a deterministic parametric base. Tests that a single blackSwanEvents entry multiplies the drawn factors only in its target year and leaves all other years untouched.
_rationale: Deterministic base: stock=5% bond=5% with 0% std dev, so every undisturbed year's blended factor is 1.05. A single black swan in 2028 (yearIndex 2) sets stockMultiplier=0.5, bondMultiplier=0.9. The overlay multiplies the drawn (1.05, 1.05) factors → (0.525, 0.945) and the blended portfolio factor for that year becomes 0.6*0.525 + 0.4*0.945 = 0.693. No spending, no income, no inflation; pure compounding shows the per-year impact.
name: Black Swan 2028 Crash
